subject: general
question: According to the Human Development Index 2021, which group of neighbouring countries has ranked behind India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pakistan and Afghanistan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the Human Development Index 2021, **Pakistan and Afghanistan** have ranked behind India among neighbouring countries.
 
• The Human Development Index (HDI) is a composite index that measures average achievement in three basic dimensions of human development: life expectancy, education, and per capita income.
